## Summary

- **`crates/hh-embed/src/context_adapters.rs`** (new, 750 lines) — the
  lane-backed adapter plane. `AdapterLane` mirrors `ModelLane` (`From<&
  ModelLane>` carries dialect/endpoint/model/credential/profile/params/
  TLS members — the runtime uses the same coordinates as the existing
  model-port machinery):
  - **`LaneEmbedder`** (`hh_context::retrieve::Embedder`) — one
    OpenAI-compatible `POST {endpoint}/embeddings` per batch, provider
    `index` order preserved, float components quantized to ppm-scaled
    `i64` with non-finite/overflow typed refusals, dimension + served
    model + verbatim usage recorded. `anthropic-messages@1` arms typed
    `Unsupported{by}` (no embeddings API — verified 2026-10-22). Empty
    batch answers empty without a wire call.
  - **`LaneSummarizer`** (`hh_context::compact::Summarizer`) — rides
    `GatewayModel::one_shot("mc.summarize")` (the lane's dialect/
    transport/credential machinery, not a second client); the
    dialect-admitted token-cap member is chosen by `plan_schema.admits`
    (`max_tokens` vs `max_completion_tokens`); the port's closed error
    lattice maps `empty_response`→`Empty`, cancellation→`Aborted`,
    overflow→`Overflow`; `usage` carries the provider's own record +
    `model_io_refs`; `instructions_ref`/`previous_summary_ref` resolve
    against caller-armed texts — an unbound ref is a typed
    `Failed{error}`, never a dropped prompt.
  - **`LaneProviderCompaction`** (`hh_context::compact_family::
    ProviderCompaction`) — `anthropic-messages@1` only: `POST /v1/
    messages` + `compaction:{type:"summarize"}` + `anthropic-beta:
    compact-2026-09-04` → `content[]{type:"compaction"}`;
    `stop_reason:"compaction"` enforced; billed counts read from
    `usage.iterations[type:"compaction"]` (top-level counts are zero —
    verified against the real response); `forgotten_ids: None` →
    `all_prior` stays verbatim (ADR-0313 (b) — Anthropic reports no
    per-item ranges). `openai@1`/`openai-compatible@1` arm typed
    `Unsupported` (the Responses `compact` item is opaque — cannot
    serve `summary_text`; the local surface has no compaction API).
- **Boundary support** — `HttpModelTransport::post_op` (+22; the one
  wire/codec home non-chat ops ride — CC1); `GatewayModel::one_shot`
  (+86; driver-free single call returning text/usage/usage_raw/
  served_model/outcome/model_io blobs for the caller's own fenced
  seam).
- **Runtime wiring, not dead code** — `KernelContext.adapter_lane`
  armed at open and re-bound from the manifest's recorded lane on
  resume; `KernelMemory::run_retrieve` Similarity queries arm
  `LaneEmbedder`; `KernelCompaction::compact` arms `LaneSummarizer` +
  `LaneProviderCompaction`. An arm-time typed refusal keeps the
  existing `unresolved{embedder}`/`UnresolvedSummarizer`/`MissingBody`
  rows — honest unbound, never a fabricated result. The scripted
  `EmbedModel` path is unchanged when no lane is armed.
- **`context-adapters` leg live-executed — PASS** — `bash scripts/
  live-verify.sh context-adapters` → committed `hh-live-evidence/1`
  record `docs/build/reports/live/2026-10-22-context-adapters.json`
  `result: pass` @2026-10-22T03:46:59Z, `provided: yes` ×4, measured
  cost **$0.000131** of the $5 allocation (cumulative $15.252252 of
  $100):
  - hosted OpenAI `text-embedding-3-small` batch — `dim=1536`,
    `prompt_tokens=91`, vectors landed the committed
    `hh-embedding-cache/1` fixture the hermetic benchset replay reads
    (`cache-recorded` marker in the transcript);
  - Anthropic provider compaction on `claude-haiku-5-5` — `chars=486`,
    `stop_reason:compaction`, usage `127 in / 232 out`;
  - local summarization — real provider answer, usage `90 in / 37 out`;
  - local embedding — the provisioned endpoint's own typed refusal

  - Honest history: an earlier attempt recorded `fail` (rc=101 — the

- **Hermetic batteries** — `tests/r4_7b.rs` ×11 over loopback fixture
